text:
Predicates:
Symptom(x) ::: x is a symptom of Monkeypox.
Coughing(x) ::: x is coughing.
Monkeypox(x) ::: x is Monkeypox.
InfectiousDisease(x) ::: x is an infectious disease.
CausedBy(x, y) ::: x is caused by y.
Virus(x) ::: x is a virus.
Animal(x) ::: x is an animal.
OccurIn(x, y) ::: x can occur in y.
Human(x) ::: x is a human.
Mammal(x) ::: x is a mammal.
Mammal(x) ::: x is a mammal.
FeelingTired(x) ::: x feels tired.
Glu(x) ::: x is a glu.

Premises:
Monkeypox(x) → InfectiousDisease(x) ::: Monkeypox is an infectious disease.
Monkeypox(x) → ∃y (Virus(y) ∧ CausedBy(y, x)) ::: Monkeypox virus can occur in certain animals, including humans.
Human(x) → Mammal(x) ::: Humans are mammals.
Mammal(x) → Animal(x) ::: Mammals are animals.
Symptom(x) → (Fever(x) ∨ Headache(x) ∨ MusclePain(x) ∨ FeelingTired(x)) ::: Symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pains, feeling tired.
FeelingTired(x) ∧ Glu(y) → FeelingTired(x) ::: People feel tired when they get a glu.

Conclusion:
Symptom(coughing) ::: Symptoms include coughing.
